fields.ei_direction: I | NEUTRAL | E | (frozen unresolved state) — copied through, never written by this layer
fields.ei_numeric: integer tier, or null when unresolved
fields.numeric_rule: the governed rule id that produced the tier or the block
fields.numeric_provenance: direction, allowed side range, base tier, applied lifts with evidence

side_invariant.★_law: ★ Numeric can never change Direction. A tier outside the resolved side is refused by NUM-FAILCLOSED-SIDE-LOCK.

rules.NUM-I-1: I → EI4 (the calibrated I tier; EI1/EI2/EI3 reserved and uncalibrated)
rules.NUM-E-BASE: E → EI6 when no governed lift condition is satisfied
rules.NUM-E-LIFT-1: E → EI7 when a governed see-through realization S08 resolves STRONG and an independent admitted openwork realization S10 is present
rules.NUM-E-LIFT-2: E → EI7 on the governed semantic conjunction of strong admitted upper-body exposure with an INDEPENDENT strong admitted lower-body exposure
rules.NUM-E-FAILCLOSED-1: E → UNRESOLVED when an admitted lower-body exposure carries a realization other than the conditional case and no governed lift applies
rules.NUM-FAILCLOSED-SIDE-LOCK: any tier outside the frozen side → UNRESOLVED (defensive; must never fire)
